name: Gulf Shores Plantation
description: Have a great vacation in this three bedroom, two unit that has everything that you need to enjoy your vacation directly on the white sands of the Gulf of Mexico. A fully equipped kitchen with updated appliances provides a home-like touch and the dining area has seating for four along with four bar stools. The living area has a sofa sleeper queen bed and a 52in flat screen Smart TV. The master bedroom has a King size bed and 48inch smart TV. The guest bedroom features two Double beds with a 42in TV and DVD player and the guest bedroom has a two twin size beds and a large flat screen tv. The kitchen, living and dining area are tiled and all bedrooms are carpeted. The Gulf Shores Plantation with 6 outdoor pools, basketball courts, tennis courts, horseshoes, shuffleboard, fitness room, putting green, hot tubs, BBQ grills, convenience store, fitness center, gift shop, hot tub, outdoor pools, restaurant, Wifi, horseshoes, putting green, shuffleboard, tennis court and an onsite ATM machine. At the facility, boardwalks lead to the beach and you will feel secure with 24 hour security and is located next to the Kiva Dunes golf course and several other golf courses in the area. The amenities are endless at the Gulf Shores Plantation! The unit is located on the top (3rd) floor of the Plantation West building with laundry facilities located on the 1st and 3rd floor. Linens and a starter set of bath towels are provided. Gulf Shores Plantation Resort is a premiere gated resort featuring 5000 feet of private beach on the Gulf of Mexico. It is a perfect vacation spot for families and those wishing to relax in a less populated area close to Gulf Shores. The climate is such that the resort can be enjoyed year round.
